status: Local definition freeze after synthetic contracts, before new funnel extraction. Original exposure counts/selections known. Descriptive post-hoc mechanism diagnosis, not independent confirmation or external preregistration.

cohort.selection: All original sixteen discovery and both reserved sources in original order, all four own-history first-repeat traces. No source/arm/event exclusions or reselection; keep all zero categories.

definitions.original_assignment: For each stage verify exact native maximize(similarity) then original gate. Weak original accepted edges = observed post-veto matched UNION original deferred edges; disjoint and one-to-one. Never rerun a tracker or install an alternative.
definitions.weak_input: Unchanged cache detection confidence, cast float32 as original _one_step; high>=.6, weak<.6. No new filter. Empty stage requires empty input/no audit/no veto; count separately, never fabricate a comparison.
definitions.opportunity: Confirmed pre-update age>=2 weak-stage row with >=1 weak input. Partition rows into no column reaching original gate, gate-supported but not accepted by original one-to-one assignment, and original accepted missed-row weak update (opportunity). Count frames, rows and edges separately.
definitions.active_competition: Per original opportunity partition: no other active confirmed age1 row; active rows but none supports target above original gate; gate support but none within original signed margin; >=1 active gate+margin competitor. Retained/unconfirmed alternatives separate, never active evidence. Preserve float32 current subtraction/comparison; no new cutoff.
definitions.past: Reconstruct each arm own append-only accepted (source frame, immutable full-cache detection index) histories, using probe ownership tokens only within that trace. Record actual high then weak accepted edges, never deferred edges or birth keys. Recreate selected last-observation context and verify every recorded past reason/qualified key strictly before decision. Distinguish missing recorded history / missing stage comparison / competitor without accepted observation from observed retained/unconfirmed/below-gate/outside-margin ineligibility. Original reason precedence retained. Missing-history side separately selected/competitor/both; no imputed birth.
definitions.protection: For each active current alternative recompute unchanged frozen protection helper from original matching; verify exact recorded reason and other-update loss. Occupied competitor and displaced other update distinct. No alternative installed, no opportunity-cost threshold. Cross past supported/missing/ineligible with protected/occupied/displaced, all nine cells including zeros.
definitions.units: Opportunity edges differ from competing alternatives. Per-edge past/protected/joint counts use any qualifying competitor, conjunction on SAME competitor. Across arms histories diverge: no row/ID joins or causal subtraction. Phase sums and conditional ratios; zero denominator = null, never zero success. Per1000 frames and per minute of nominal source duration are descriptive, not FPS or independent-event rates.
definitions.checks: Consecutive full frames/cache splits; exact pre-veto assignment; remaining snapshots; accepted-history ages; all original audit/veto/competitor lists/past/protection reasons; all ten prior public exposure counts and phase/trace/cache seals. All counters fixed whitelist, raw opportunity locations local.

buffer_erratum.prior_text: Earlier KITTI reports/frozen prose incorrectly described lost_track_buffer30 as30 native frames/3seconds, and MOT25Hz as1.2seconds.
buffer_erratum.actual: Pinned native helper max(1,ceil(frame_rate/30*lost_track_buffer)); parameter30 gives configured maximum_frames_without_update10/25/30 at10/25/30Hz, nominal1second in all three. maximum_time_without_update=30/30=1. Snapshot/fixed-step ages remain native frame units; equality/lifecycle boundaries are not certified physical timeouts.
buffer_erratum.scope: Documentation interpretation correction only. Original parameters, code, caches, traces, selections and their frozen hashes retained byte-for-byte. No tracking rerun, source substitution, duration fit or causal attribution to the buffer.

forbidden: No new inference/tracking, GT/labels/scores/evaluator invocation, accuracy selection, parameter changes, source replacement, intervention or default promotion. Existing known GT scores are not inputs.
public_scope: Only source seals, all-source counts/conditional ratios/reasons and numeric chart. Original matrices, frame positions, IDs, accepted observations, cases and paths local. Original source terms/attribution and noncommercial local scope inherited unchanged.
